dispute_description: Pidilite Industries Ltd is the registered owner of the iconic trademark FEVICOL for adhesives and construction chemicals, which has acquired the status of a well-known mark in India enjoying enormous goodwill built over five decades. Pidigen Adhesives Pvt Ltd has launched a range of adhesive products under the brand name FEVIGEN using a similar red-and-white color combination, a bucket-shaped packaging design, and overall trade dress closely resembling the FEVICOL packaging. The phonetic similarity between FEVICOL and FEVIGEN, combined with near-identical packaging trade dress in the same product category sold through overlapping distribution channels, creates a false impression in the minds of consumers and the trade that FEVIGEN is a variant of or associated with the FEVICOL brand. No prior contractual relationship exists. Pidilite seeks a permanent injunction and damages of Rs 75 lakhs for brand similarity and trademark infringement.
